newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling down on dollar and pound.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling down on dollar and pound.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling ended the week lower compared to the dollar and pound, central bank dealers said on Friday.
Dealers said the shilling continued a marginal decline in line with market expectations.
The shilling exchanged at a commercial mean rate of 600.1974 compared to Thursday's mean of 600.1875. Last Friday, the shilling exchanged against the dollar for 599.9796.
On the pound, it was traded at a mean rate of 968.9617 down slightly on Thursday's 968.0145, central bank figures showed.
Financial analysts and traders said there was little concern in the market about the downward trend of the shilling.
One key factor underpinning the strength of the shilling was the government's ability to keep within its budget forecasts on expenditure and this was on track, one analyst said.
